review: Both source floor diagrams inspected. Already orthographic. First-floor outlines54-95/110 and second-floor outlines236-252 contain partitions; thin tread/curve lines56/82/238/240/242/243/245 are flat details. Legends and external service leaders are excluded. Source provides collection zones but no individual room IDs, so names are used without fabricating room numbers. Collection anchor coordinates lie inside their original colored areas.
